name: SplatXR On-Headset 3D Gaussian Splatting Renderer
definition: A renderer implementation for Unity that renders 3D Gaussian splats on-headset in Extended Reality, supporting both in-editor previews and on-headset rendering with automatic camera switching.
summary: SplatXR is a Unity renderer for XR headsets that offloads 3D Gaussian Splatting depth-sorting to a background CPU thread to reduce GPU overhead.
